J1.name: J-1 Proton Cannon
J1.notes: Proton blast — unique targets, no repeats. Needs crew.

AAT.name: AAT Tank
AAT.notes: Heavy cannon blast — unique targets, no repeats. Needs crew.

CloneHeavy.name: Clone Heavy Gunner
CloneHeavy.notes: Z-6 rotary cannon — spray fire, targets by weight with repeats.

targeting_rules.random: Use 'round' command — unit fires at random enemy from opposing faction. For dumb/untrained units (B1, militia, beasts).
targeting_rules.aimed: Use 'attack' command — unit picks specific target. For trained soldiers, commanders, heroes, snipers.
targeting_rules.aoe: Use 'aoe'/'turret' command — splash damage with DEX/STR save. Two modes: blast (unique targets, no repeats — explosions, cannons) and spray (weighted with repeats — rotary guns, auto-fire). Default is blast.

combat_rules.cover: +2 AC while in cover. Whole group enters/leaves cover together.
combat_rules.surprise_round: Ambushing side gets one free round before initiative.
combat_rules.morale: When group loses 50%+ units, remaining may flee (DM discretion, WIS DC 12).
combat_rules.crewed_units: Units with 'crewed: true' in template need at least 1 non-crewed unit alive in their group to fire. Kill all crew = weapon offline but alive (can be recaptured). J1 and AAT are crewed.
combat_rules.zone_grouping: Units in the same physical area share a group. Incoming fire randomly hits any unit in the zone. AC regulates hit chance naturally — turret AC 18 gets hit less than crew AC 13 by same attacker.
combat_rules.reinforcements: Can add units mid-battle with 'add' command.
combat_rules.attack_range: Units have range: 'ranged' (default, any group), 'melee' (same group only), 'both' (either). Melee units must move to target group first. Custom units set range via --range flag on add.
